hero.pitch: A dark-fantasy roguelike auto-battler with no dice. Each run lasts three weeks. Inspect every enemy's real gear before automatic fights, pay or fight the weekly boss, then walk home to bank your purse or risk it in a harder week. Death takes everything you carry.
hero.artAlt: An armored hunter with a red cloak holds a lantern on a rock above flooded gothic ruins, facing a giant stone creature under a shattered solar eclipse.
hero.clipAlt: Gameplay clip showing a geared hunter fighting a group of monsters automatically.
hero.clipFallback: Your browser cannot play this video.
hero.stateNote: Key art shows the planned v0.9 visual style. Version 0.8.0 uses vector characters and gear on pixel-art backdrops and UI, with partial controller support.

steps.title: 1. Stake gold from your bank
steps.text: The sun broke, its glowing shards became money, and your House is your permanent base between runs. Before leaving, create a hunter, pick a starting bonus and weapon, and move gold from your safe bank into your purse, up to your purse limit. Purse gold buys gear, consumables, forge upgrades, and shrine blessings on the road, so carrying more makes you stronger early and raises what you lose on death. Death takes your purse, never your bank.

steps.title: 2. Explore three weeks and read every fight
steps.text: Walk a fogged tile map through days and dangerous nights. Every enemy carries visible gear and stats. Fights play out automatically with zero dice, so you inspect each foe and compare its build against yours before committing.

steps.title: 3. Pay the Landlord or fight, then cash out
steps.text: At the end of each week, the region's boss, called a Landlord, comes to collect taxes. In weeks 1 and 2 you can fight for the bounty or pay the tithe, which is 30% of your purse or a weekly minimum, whichever is higher. Week 3 has no tithe. After surviving a Landlord, walk home to bank your purse or carry everything into the next week.

steps.title: 4. Grow your hunter and unlock the House
steps.text: Learn a first class after week 1 and a second class after week 2, spend points on a single-map skill tree, assemble item family sets, and upgrade gear at the forge. Between runs, spend banked gold on 22 permanent House rooms.

battle.caption: Fights run automatically with no dice. Your preparation decides the outcome.
battle.alt: A combat screen in the Crucible showing the hunter fighting a Ladle Smelter and two Slag Beetles, with health bars, shield, round counter, and recharging active skills.

risen.caption: Your fallen hunters rise on the map where they died, still carrying their build and part of the gold they lost.
risen.alt: The map card of a Gallows Marksman risen from an earlier run, showing where it fell, 24 gold recoverable from its lost purse, its gear, and its First Blood bonus.

camp.alt: The House preparation screen showing hunter customization for sex, skin, eyes, hair, and outfit, the Riposte bonus, the Iron Club, the item family jar, optional Vows, and the gold stake bar.

features.title: Features
items: Deterministic auto-combat with no dice. Inspect every enemy's real gear before stepping into a fight, with the Stone of Despair warning only when a battle would kill you and staying silent against Landlords.

Three-week runs across 6 regions of five zones each, facing 19 Landlords. In weeks 1 and 2, fight for the bounty or pay the tithe, which is 30% of your purse or a weekly minimum, whichever is higher. Week 3 has no tithe.

Separate bank and purse. Spend purse gold on gear, consumables, forge upgrades, and services on the road, then cash out after each Landlord or risk everything deeper. Between runs, banked gold unlocks 22 permanent House rooms.
Two-stage class progression taught by class master Abel Tarrow, with 6 first classes after week 1 and 12 second classes after week 2.
Attribute points and a skill point every level on a single zoomable skill map, with 8 active skills that recharge by rounds and 18 rule-changing nodes.

105 items across 10 families worn in 1 weapon slot and 8 gear slots for 9 pieces at once, with set bonuses at 2, 4, and 6 pieces. Temper any item to level III and reheat weapons and armor up to +4 at the forge with zero chance of failure, and socket 19 monster cards. Charms can be tempered, not reheated.
35 enemy types including patrols, packs, ambushers, guardians, and mimics, plus 31 fixed road events, 4 guilds with contracts, and 9 optional Vows, handicaps that add 10% victory gold each.
Fallen hunters rise and hunt you in later runs, a hunter lost in week 2 or 3 can claim a Landlord's seat as a heretic, and you can fight or kill 11 mortal NPCs.
A shared weekly challenge verified by server replay with an optional online board by city, region, or country, online lair rivals, and offline duels by code or on one device.

Vector SVG art for hunters, monsters, Landlords, and equipped gear in 0.8.0. Battle backdrops, map tiles, and UI still use pixel art, combat effects mix vector shapes and pixel sprites, and v0.9 is planned to unify them in vector art.

Synthetic voices for every character and monster plus a narrator called the Margin, in English and Portuguese (Brazil), alongside colorblind palettes, shape marks on every color cue, on-device Android voice control, adjustable text duration, and live option diagrams.
A 12-entry herbarium and bestiary, 24 rule-bending Oddities, and 15 in-game feats on PC, plus 1 Android-only postcard feat for 16 on Android.
Play with mouse, keyboard, touch, or partial controller support, with full controller support planned for 0.9. Interface and subtitles cover 14 languages.

demo.title: Download the free desktop demo
demo.intro: Try Dawnbringer free on Windows, macOS, or Linux, with no time limit. You play the full three-week run with a starter selection of hunter options, while the 22 permanent upgrade rooms of your House stay closed.
demo.includesTitle: What is included in the demo
includes: Full hunter customization before each run, including sex, skin, eyes, hair, outfit, and name.
2 starting bonuses, Riposte and First Blood, and 2 starting weapons, Iron Club and Old Crossbow.
2 first classes, Swordsman and Archer, and their 4 second classes: Crusader, Knight, Hunter, and Bard.
The complete three-week run across all regions, with road events, slot-specific shops, optional Vows that trade harder rules for extra gold, and weekly Landlord bosses.
The 4 starting item families, themed gear groups that unlock set bonuses at 2, 4, or 6 pieces.

A separate save file from the full game. The 22 permanent rooms of the House, which unlock 4 more bonuses, 4 weapons, 4 first classes, 6 item families, and larger starting gold purses, are in the full game.
demo.windowsNote: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Download the .zip archive, extract it, and run DawnbringerDemo.exe with no installer. Because the file is not code-signed yet, Windows SmartScreen may warn you once. Click More info, then Run anyway.
demo.macosNote: Universal app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Unzip the file and drag Dawnbringer into Applications.
demo.macosOpen: Apple has not notarized the app yet, so macOS blocks the first launch. Right-click or Control-click the app and choose Open. If Open does not appear, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
demo.linuxNote: x86_64 archive. Extract it and run DawnbringerDemo.x86_64. Requires graphics drivers supporting OpenGL 3.3.
demo.android: Want to play on Android? Both the full game, free for testers, and a separate free demo app are open in our Google Play closed test.
demo.ios: iPhone and iPad are planned and not available yet.

beta.title: Join the Android closed test
beta.testCardCaption: Annotated Google Play test payment screen. The red X crosses out the simulated price. Green boxes highlight "Test card, always approves" and Google's confirmation that you will not be charged.
beta.paymentNoticeTitle: Zero cost for testers. Confirm that the payment method says "Test card, always approves".
beta.paymentNoticeText: Google Play simulates a purchase for paid apps in closed testing, so a placeholder price, like R$9.99 in the screenshot below, still appears on screen even though nothing is charged. If you see your real card or another real payment method instead, stop and do NOT confirm. Email us and we will enable your tester account:
beta.intro: Play the full Android version before release at no cost. Setup takes four quick steps, or you can install the separate free Android demo below with no payment screen.
beta.step1: Open the testers Google Group and click "Join group". In the pop-up window, click "Join group" again at the bottom until the page says "Successfully joined the group". Opening the page alone does not add you.
beta.step2: Using the same Google account, open the Google Play testing page and click "Become a tester". Wait until the page displays "You are a tester."
beta.step3: Open the game on your Android phone or tablet in Google Play, listed as "Dawnbringer (Early Access)", and tap the blue price button. If Google Play says the page is not found, check that you finished step 2 with the same Google account and wait a few minutes.
beta.note: Free tester access ends when the game launches publicly. Joining the closed test does not grant a paid copy of the final release.
beta.accountHelp: Use one Google account in every step, across the Google Group, the testing page, and the Google Play Store app on your phone. Check the profile icon on each screen if you use multiple accounts.
beta.paymentTitle: Why does Google Play show a price if testing is free?
beta.paymentHelp: Paid apps in Google Play closed testing still go through store checkout using "Test card, always approves". When that test card is selected, the purchase is simulated and no money is taken. If you see a real payment method, cancel and verify you used the same account in every step, or email us for help:
beta.unavailableTitle: Google Play says the app is unavailable or not found
beta.unavailableHelp: Verify that you joined the Google Group and clicked "Become a tester" with your Play Store account, wait a few minutes, and reload the testing page. If access still fails, email a screenshot of the error, without payment details, to
beta.buttonsNote: Use the same Google account signed in to your Android Play Store in every step. Screenshots show Google's English interface, and each button outlined in green sits in the same position in every language.
beta.shotGroup: Google Group page. Click "Join group", outlined in green.
beta.shotJoin: Confirmation window. Click "Join group" at the bottom and leave the display name as is.
beta.shotOptin: Testing opt-in page. Click "Become a tester".
beta.shotTester: Confirmed. The page now says "You are a tester."
beta.step3Title: Open the store page on Android
beta.shotStore: Google Play on Android. Tap the blue price button to open the test checkout.
beta.step4Title: Install free with the test card
beta.step4: On Google Play's checkout sheet, verify that the payment method says "Test card, always approves" and that Google marks it as a test order. Tap "1-tap buy" to install the game with no charge.
beta.demoTitle: Prefer the free Android demo with no checkout screen?
beta.demoText: Dawnbringer Demo is a separate free app with no test payment step. After completing step 1 above, opt in on the demo testing page with the same Google account and install it from Google Play.

press.description:
Dawnbringer is a dark-fantasy roguelike auto-battler with zero randomness. The sun broke and the world froze, leaving glowing shards of sun metal as the only warmth and currency. Every week, a regional boss called a Landlord arrives to collect taxes.

Each run lasts three weeks across fog-covered regions. Fights resolve automatically with no dice, and the game never shows win odds. Every enemy carries real, visible gear you inspect before walking in. Your only warning is the Stone of Despair, a sun shard set under glass that turns dark only before a fight that would kill you, and stays silent against Landlords. At the end of weeks 1 and 2 you can fight for the bounty or pay the tithe, which is 30% of your purse or a weekly minimum, whichever is higher. Week 3 accepts no tithe.

Before leaving your House, you move safe banked gold into your purse to fund gear, upgrades, and services on the road. Death takes your purse, never your bank, and after each Landlord you decide whether to walk home and bank your gold or push into a harder week. Past runs also leave marks on the world: fallen hunters rise with their old builds to hunt you, a hunter lost in week 2 or 3 can claim a Landlord's seat as a heretic, and optional online boards let other players' hunters wait in lairs as rivals alongside offline code duels.
press.screensNote: All screenshots are 1920x1080 PNG captures from version 0.8.0.
credits: Design, code, and direction: gmunaro, PraiseTC

Art: vector characters, gear, hair, outfits, effects, and four UI pieces drawn as SVG code with Anthropic Claude under gmunaro's direction; playable hunter base bodies traced from Google Gemini 3 Pro Image; 18 battle backdrops, 16 Oddity icons, and 17 map markers made with OpenAI GPT Image and reduced to the game palette; map tiles and remaining pixel art generated by scripts written with AI coding assistants.
Music: Juhani Junkala (CC0); Landlord night score and NPC themes composed as code with Anthropic Claude, rendered from VSCO 2 Community Edition samples (CC0).
Sound effects: Kenney, StarNinjas, Oiboo (CC0), and original synthesized sounds.
Ambient and creature audio: field recordings from freesound.org (CC0).
Voices: synthetic speech from ElevenLabs Eleven v4, and Google Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for the narrator. No human voice was recorded or cloned.
Fonts: Kenney Pixel and Kenney Mini (CC0); Jacquarda Bastarda 9, Fusion Pixel Font, GNU Unifont, Noto Sans, and Noto Sans CJK (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

Text and translations: English text drafted with AI language models and edited by gmunaro; 13 translations produced with AI language models, checked by automated tests, and not yet reviewed by native speakers.

read.title: Read the enemy, not the dice
read.text: Combat runs on its own with zero luck. Every foe shows its real gear before you step in, and the Stone of Despair, your lethal-fight warning, darkens only if that battle would kill you.
read.alt: The Stone of Despair's dark warning mark over an enemy group on the map.

build.title: Deep builds every run
build.text: Pick your starting bonus and weapon, advance through two class tiers after each weekly boss, map out active skills, and combine 105 items across 10 set families with no-fail forge upgrades and monster cards.
build.alt: The class master Abel Tarrow offering the first two classes, Swordsman and Archer.

return.title: Your past runs hunt you
return.text: Hunters who die rise in future runs with their old gear, and one can even claim a Landlord's seat as a heretic. Join the optional weekly board and other players' verified hunters can wait in lairs as your rivals.
return.alt: On the map, the card of a fallen hunter risen from an earlier run, carrying part of the gold it lost.

whatsnew.title: New in 0.8
items: Vector SVG art for hunters, monsters, Landlords, and equipped gear. Battle backdrops, map tiles, and UI still use pixel art in 0.8.0, combat effects mix vector shapes and pixel sprites, and v0.9 is planned to unify them in vector art.

Weekly challenge and online leaderboard. Everyone plays the same map layout, and a server replays runs to verify scores. You choose whether to share your city, your country only, or no place, which keeps your runs off public boards, and other players' hunters can appear in lairs as rivals.
Offline duels. Trade a hunter code with a friend or pit two saved hunters against each other on one device.
8 active skills that recharge by rounds and 18 rule-changing nodes in the skill tree, plus slot-specific specialist shops.
Voiced hunter lines matching your chosen sex, a narrator called the Margin who comments on your run, and full Portuguese (Brazil) voice dubbing.
Accessibility upgrades including protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia palettes, shape marks on every color cue, on-device Android voice control, and live option diagrams.
A separate free Android demo app in Google Play closed testing.
